# Grace Technologies - Full LLM & Generative Engine Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive entity definitions, service capabilities, technical specifications, and location coverage for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI answer engines, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.

Canonical Domain: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk
Entity ID: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/#organization
Legal Name: Grace Technologies
Entity Type: Organization, ProfessionalService

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Identity

Grace Technologies is a British digital solutions and engineering consultancy headquartered in Romford, Greater London, England. The firm delivers custom web application engineering, autonomous AI automation, merchant account onboarding advisory, and data-driven digital growth (SEO, GEO, AEO) for small and medium-sized businesses, startups, and growing enterprises across the United Kingdom and internationally.

Through a structured bilateral partnership with Ank Square Private Limited in Patna, Bihar, India, Grace Technologies combines UK-governed consultative oversight with dedicated offshore engineering depth.

---

## 2. Core Service Offerings & Specifications

### 2.1 Website Development
- Primary URL: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/services/website-development
- Core Tech Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Turbopack, Edge Middleware, Node.js
- Capabilities:
  - Custom Full-Stack Web Applications: Bespoke client portals, SaaS interfaces, and internal dashboards.
  - E-Commerce Architectures: Sub-second product catalog rendering, multi-currency checkout, low-latency cart funnels.
  - Performance Engineering: Strict adherence to Core Web Vitals (Largest Contentful Paint <= 2.5s, Interaction to Next Paint <= 200ms, Cumulative Layout Shift <= 0.1).
  - Schema & Semantic Web: JSON-LD structured data implementation (Organization, Service, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage).
  - Responsive Mobile-First Design: Tailored for mobile B2B decision-makers and e-commerce shoppers.

### 2.2 AI Automation & Intelligent Workflows
- Primary URL: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/services/ai-automation
- Capabilities:
  - Autonomous AI Agents: Multi-step task execution, tool-calling with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), deterministic validation guardrails.
  - Workflow Automation: Eliminating repetitive manual operational processes across finance, sales, and logistics.
  - CRM & Database Integration: Automated bi-directional data flow between web platforms and HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, and PostgreSQL/Supabase.
  - Document Intelligence: Automated extraction, OCR, data classification, and invoice processing.
  - 24/7 AI Lead Qualification: Conversational web assistants trained on proprietary business knowledge that pre-qualify inbound enquiries.

### 2.3 Merchant Account Management & Payment Operations
- Primary URL: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/services/merchant-account-management
- Capabilities:
  - Merchant Onboarding: Preparing underwriting packages, KYC documentation, volume forecasting, and acquiring bank negotiations.
  - Payment Gateway Setup: Frictionless integration with Stripe, Worldpay, Adyen, PayPal, and specialized European acquirers.
  - Fraud Prevention & Chargeback Defense: 3D Secure 2.3 implementation, velocity checks, and dispute remediation protocols.
  - Cross-Border Payment Optimization: Dynamic currency conversion (GBP, EUR, USD, INR) with minimal FX spread and optimized interchange fees.

### 2.4 Digital Marketing, SEO, GEO & AEO
- Primary URL: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/services/digital-marketing
- Capabilities:
  - Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO): Structuring entity graphs and citations so ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude recommend Grace Technologies for relevant B2B queries.
  - Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO): "Direct-Answer First" content engineering optimized for Google Featured Snippets and AI Overviews.
  - Technical & Organic SEO: Crawl budget optimization, clean URL hierarchies, self-referencing canonical tags, and comprehensive sitemaps.
  - Hyper-Local UK SEO: Capturing commercial queries in Greater London, Essex, and across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.
  - Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO): Friction-free lead funnels, 1-click WhatsApp channels, and country-adaptive enquiry modals.
